name: Windows NetBIOS Node Type P-node
description:
Ensures NetBIOS name resolution uses only WINS (P-node, NodeType = 2), so NetBIOS broadcasts cannot be spoofed to capture credentials.
Required Windows permission (remedy only): the LEA agent account must be allowed to run reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NetBT\Parameters" /v NodeType (administrator rights) via a delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.

remedy.command: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NetBT\Parameters" /v NodeType /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f | Out-Null; reg query "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NetBT\Parameters" /v NodeType
